name: Telescoping Cost Obfuscation
description: Replaced the explicit cost increment `p1 + p2 - allocated` with the algebraically identical `p1 + B_new - B_old`. This removes the constant `p1 + p2` term from the step-by-step rules. Models must now sum the telescoping series to realize the total cost is `sum(p1) + B_final`. Minimizing the final state of a clamped recurrence is highly counter-intuitive and breaks their heuristic of maximizing the total allocated amount.
